step1_analysis.circuit_type: Substrate and Power Distribution Network (PDN) RC Model
step1_analysis.description: A passive RC network modeling the power distribution network and substrate coupling paths in a digital ASIC. It is used to simulate how switching noise on the power supply couples into the substrate.

paper_reference.title: Substrate Noise Generation in Complex Digital Systems: Efficient Modeling and Simulation Methodology and Experimental Verification

Coupling_100MHz.description: Voltage transfer function from VDD to substrate at 100 MHz

sky130_expected.calculation: At 100 MHz, the series impedance of the coupling capacitors is around 27 ohms, while the substrate shunt resistor R3 is 0.12 ohms. The voltage divider yields 20*log10(0.12/27) ~= -47 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the RC voltage divider formed by the coupling capacitors and the substrate resistance to ground.

Coupling_1GHz.description: Voltage transfer function from VDD to substrate at 1 GHz

sky130_expected.calculation: At 1 GHz, the series impedance of the coupling capacitors drops to around 2.7 ohms. The voltage divider yields 20*log10(0.12/2.7) ~= -27 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Higher frequency reduces capacitive impedance, increasing the coupling to the substrate.

Z_VDD_100MHz.description: Input impedance of the VDD network at 100 MHz

sky130_expected.calculation: The total effective capacitance seen at VDD is roughly 150 pF. Z = 1 / (2 * pi * 100MHz * 150pF) ~= 10.6 ohms.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dominated by the parallel combination of decoupling and parasitic capacitors connected to VDD.

step3_testbench.description: AC analysis to measure substrate coupling and PDN impedance over frequency.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Substrate Noise Model Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* DUT
R1 substrate N6 0.75
R2 N2 substrate 0.21
R3 substrate VSS 0.12
R4 substrate N7 0.57
C1 VDDE VSS 145p
C2 VSS VSSE 218p
C3 VSSE N7 52p
C4 VDD N6 19p
C5 VDD VSS 77p
C6 VDDE N2 53p
C7 VDDE VSSE 42p
C8 VDD VSSE 30p
C9 VDD VDDE 33p

* DC paths for floating nodes to prevent singular matrix errors
R_dc_vdde VDDE 0 1G
R_dc_vsse VSSE 0 1G

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 DC 1.8 AC 1
VVSS VSS 0 DC 0

.control
ac dec 100 1Meg 10G

let coupling_db = vdb(substrate)
let z_vdd_mag = 1 / mag(i(VVDD))

meas ac coupling_100M find coupling_db at=100MEG
meas ac coupling_1G find coupling_db at=1G
meas ac z_vdd_100M find z_vdd_mag at=100MEG
meas ac z_vdd_1G find z_vdd_mag at=1G

print coupling_100M coupling_1G z_vdd_100M z_vdd_1G
quit
.endc
.end
